description: Source file implementing the Resolver class for managing configurations, resolving aliases, parsing alias strings, and invoking Thunder plugins within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: Resolver
classes.description: Class responsible for managing resolution configurations, parsing aliases, and invoking Thunder plugins within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

methods.name: LoadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration from a JSON file, parsing resolutions and storing them internally.

methods.name: IsConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the resolver has any configurations loaded.

methods.name: ResolveAlias
methods.description: Retrieves the alias associated with a given key.

methods.name: ParseAlias
methods.description: Parses an alias string into callsign and method components.

methods.name: ExtractStringField
methods.description: Extracts a string field from a JSON variant container.

methods.name: ExtractBooleanField
methods.description: Extracts a boolean field from a JSON variant container with a default fallback.

methods.name: ExtractAdditionalContext
methods.description: Extracts additional context JSON value from a JSON object.

methods.name: CallThunderPlugin
methods.description: Invokes a Thunder plugin method via JSONRPC using the alias.

methods.name: HasEvent
methods.description: Checks if a resolution has an associated event.

methods.name: HasIncludeContext
methods.description: Checks if a resolution includes context and retrieves it.

methods.name: HasComRpcRequestSupport
methods.description: Checks if a resolution supports ComRpc requests.

methods.name: HasPermissionGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the permission group associated with a resolution.
